interventions.detail: Used Python 3.8 (uv venv) instead of Python 2
Used torch==1.7.1+cpu wheel, which bundles caffe2 and a CPU libcaffe2_detectron_ops.so, instead of a CUDA Caffe2 source build
env.py: fall back to CPU libcaffe2_detectron_ops.so when the _gpu ops lib is absent
c2.py: CudaDevice returns a CPU DeviceOption when no CUDA devices exist
env.py: yaml_load uses yaml.UnsafeLoader so the cfg embedded in model_final.pkl loads with newer PyYAML
numpy<1.20, protobuf<3.21, matplotlib<3.4, opencv-python-headless<4.6, pyyaml 5.3.1 instead of 3.12
pycocotools from pip instead of the cocoapi make install
Ran python setup.py develop directly because make adds --user inside a venv
setup.sh embeds the CPU patch as a heredoc and wraps network steps in retries so it runs on a fresh container
